title: fix(lint): one-line fix hints for the six data-model-rules ids (#22161 slice 18)
body:
Part of #22161
Clause-②: no

Slice 18 of #22161 (claim `6213942673`): every rule id in `packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.ts` whose `fix` ran past 200 characters now prints one remedy line. The text those lines used to explain is in `RULE_EXPLANATIONS`, which `os explain RULE_ID` prints. This follows the shape of slices 11–17. Messages, ids, severities, paths and accept/refuse results do not change.

## Before → after (characters of the fix text, longest variant measured)

| Rule id | Severity | Reported by | Before | After |
|:---|:---|:---|---:|---:|
| `unique/legacy-organization-composite` | warning | `os validate` / `os build` (registry `hint`), `os lint` | 592 | 161 |
| `unique/unscoped-declared-index` | error | all three commands (registry `hint`) | 380 | 150 |
| `object/missing-name-field` | suggestion | `os lint` only (`lintDataModel`) | 327 | 188 |
| `unique/double-declaration` | warning | `os validate` / `os build` (registry `hint`), `os lint` | 303 | 159 |
| `rollup/non-numeric-aggregand` | error | `os lint` only (`lintDataModel`) | 300 | 165 |
| `field/select-missing-options` | warning | `os lint` only (`lintDataModel`) | 207 | 180 |

The probe that measured these calls the built `@objectstack/lint` dist directly. It covers every arm of each rule (both index spellings, all four scope quadrants, a declared tenant column, every option-field type, nine child types under `min` and `max`) with long object and column names. The base readings match slice 16's report (578 / 380 / 327 / 279 / 207). The higher 592 / 303 / 300 come from the longer names in the probe. Base `6db53acd6`, branch `492ab98d`.

## What moved where

- `unique/unscoped-declared-index`: the line keeps the two scope words. What `'organization'` makes the driver build, and the `os migrate meta --from 17` house sentence for existing sources, are now a new paragraph of its explanation. The sentence is still a single plain-quoted literal, so `retired-key-migrate-sentence.test.ts` still judges it.
- `unique/legacy-organization-composite`: the line is "respell + keep `fields` + the `recreate_index` / pre-flight cost". The in-place NULL-safety, what the constraint then means, and the probe's report-instead-of-boot-failure moved to its explanation. The line no longer depends on the column list.
- `unique/double-declaration`: the contradiction arm no longer names the column or where each word may live. That is now an explanation paragraph. The two redundancy arms were already under 200 and drop one word.
- `object/missing-name-field`: the line now points at `os explain title-format-retired`, whose existing entry already says why a `titleFormat` template does not count. No new entry was added: an entry needs an exported id constant, which would widen `@objectstack/lint`'s public surface. That is outside this slice's `Clause-②: no`.
- `rollup/non-numeric-aggregand`: the line no longer names the parent object, so its length no longer grows with that name. The existing entry already carries the reasoning.
- `field/select-missing-options`: trimmed wording only.

## The census blind spot (the dispatch's mechanism hypothesis, measured)

The slice-17 push-preload census reads objects that carry a `hint`, which is the `AuthoringFinding` shape. Replicated at base: 231 ids carry a `hint`, the same count slice 17 reported. `object/missing-name-field`, `rollup/non-numeric-aggregand` and `field/select-missing-options` DO fire in the lint suite, but only as `LintIssue.fix`, because `lintDataModel` is not a registry rule and nothing adapts its findings into a `hint`. So the census missed them because of the shape it reads, not because the suite never fired them. Recording `fix` too gives 327 / 282 / 207 at base. The new test file reads `fix` directly over every arm.

## Runtime reach

None of the six runs at the runtime publish gate. The three uniqueness entries are `surfaces: CLI_ONLY`, and the other three run only in `os lint`'s sweep. Measured with `runRuntimeAuthoringRules({ type: 'object', … })` on one write per id: 10 rules run, the control `security-owd-unset` fires, and none of the six does. So no 422 `issues[].hint` or 2xx `advisories[].hint` changes.

## Tests

- New `packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.fix-lines.test.ts`: an exact-line pin for each id's fix, a bound of one line and ≤200 characters over every finding fired across all six ids (with a coverage control requiring all six to fire), and the facts the moved text now carries in `os explain`.
- Ablation (committed `55223df1`, via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` under the lock): the old tail was restored on `unique/legacy-organization-composite` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `dd03cc6b34c6` → `15bc83a0f5ab`). Predicted exactly 2 red; observed `Tests 2 failed | 6 passed (8)` (the exact-line pin and the bound). Restored: blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty.
- `@objectstack/lint`: 141 files / 6790 tests passed and `typecheck` passed (tsc + check:test-typecheck), at merge head `3993be17dd`. Earlier at `55223df1`: 141 / 6789.
- CLI unit tier at `492ab98d`: 300 / 302 files on the full run, 4469 tests passed. The 2 failing files were a prerequisite (the CLI's own `dist` was not built) and passed after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli build`, together with `test/data-model-rules.test.ts` (3 files, 85 tests). Every existing pin on these fixes (ADR-0079, titleFormat, both scope words, "the exact index bare true built", "keep fields exactly as they are", recreate_index, pre-flight, and the options / picklist pair) still holds unchanged.
- `@objectstack/spec` `test:repo` at `492ab98d`: 63 files / 1070 tests passed. This includes the house-sentence scan over the moved sentence.
- `os validate` and `os lint` with the built CLI on app-crm, app-todo, app-showcase and app-multi-package: all exit 0. `os validate` reports none of the six. `os lint` reports `object/missing-name-field` 5 times (1 on crm, 4 on showcase), and its `→ fix:` line is now 188 characters.
- Merged `origin/main` once (no conflict). #23836's `rule-explanations.ts` edit is in another entry.

## Remaining after this slice (this census, hint-shaped, over 200, by file)

The slice-17 census, replicated at base `6db53acd6`, finds 32 ids. This slice removes three; the other three of its six were never hint-shaped. Recording `fix` finds no other fix-only id over 200.

- `lint-flow-patterns.ts` (14)
- `validate-page-field-bindings.ts` (4)
- `lint-startup-registry-verdict.ts` (3)
- `validate-flow-template-paths.ts` (2)
- one each: `validate-component-props.ts`, `validate-list-view-mode.ts`, `validate-form-layout.ts`, `validate-filter-tokens.ts`, `validate-capability-references.ts`, `validate-print-page-blocks.ts`

Slice 19 (claim `6213957180`) covers several of these files. The per-id list is in the report on #22161. The count differs from slice 17's 33 (with `lint-flow-patterns.ts` at 2). The id→file mapping here is a `git grep` of the literal id, which can attribute an id to the first file that spells it. This is a reading, not a correction of the earlier one.

## Acceptance notes

- No `RULE_EXPLANATIONS` entry for `object/missing-name-field` or `field/select-missing-options`. Giving them one needs exported id constants (a public-surface widening). The first id points at `title-format-retired`'s entry instead, and the second lost no reasoning.
